verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public REST API with token-based authentication, scopes, an active changelog, Postman collections and an llms.txt index. Programmatic control is documented across many resources, including transactions, budgets, payments, team/users, expenses, accounting, travel and webhooks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard path (probes of the candidate paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
The payments API allows you to initiate and manage payments and vendors from your Brex business accounts.
The budgets API lets you manage your Brex Budgets and Spend Limits.
Team API: Added Create user (`POST /v2/users/create`) to create an inactive employee without sending an invitation.
go to the Brex developer workspace which has collections for all of the Brex APIs
